payload.summary: scripts/probe-generation-quality.ts prints no answer text, so a blinded Gate E before/after read cannot come from probes
payload.detail: The probe reports structured generation_quality_gate_reasons only, by design, and never the answer text itself. That makes it impossible to produce a blinded before/after Gate E (answer-quality) read from probe output alone. Needs an owner-approved answer-text capture mode added to the probe, or a manual read of the app's rendered answer, before any future packet can close a blinded Gate E comparison this way.
